summary: Petrobras filed a routine Form 6-K disclosing receipt of R$423.7 million for gasoline sales (June 16-30), R$601.5 million for diesel sales (June 16-30), and R$0.6 million in supplemental gasoline subsidy (August 1-15) under Brazilian Economic Subvention Programs (Provisional Measures 1,358 and 1,359). Cumulative receipts under diesel, gasoline, and LPG subsidy programs total roughly R$13.3 billion. No securities transaction, ownership change, or corporate action is involved; the filing is an ordinary operational cash-receipt update by a foreign private issuer, with no board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms.
